name: Surrogate Objective-based Trajectory Planning
aliases: Surrogate Objectives for Active Radiance Fields Network
definition: A deep neural network that predicts surrogate objective scores (Surface Coverage C, Geometric Complexity Q, Textural Complexity T, Ray Diversity D) for candidate camera poses given an input mesh, enabling fast trajectory planning without training a radiance field.
summary: Surrogate Objective-based Trajectory Planning uses SOARNet to rapidly select informative camera poses for radiance fields without training a model or accessing ground-truth meshes.
